name: Training Time Estimator
description: Estimates training time for ML models. Single mode: select a dataset node. Multiple mode: choose datasets from dropdown menus and compare sequential vs parallel training times.

configStructure.name: mode
configStructure.description: Single: estimate for selected dataset node only. Multiple: configure multiple datasets manually

configStructure.name: modelType
configStructure.description: Type of regression model to use for prediction

configStructure.name: processingMode
configStructure.description: Sequential: models train one after another (sum times). Parallel: models train simultaneously (max time)

configStructure.name: dataset1_samples
configStructure.description: Number of training samples (use arrows to adjust)
